title.ko: 인용과 출처 표기: according to · cite · quote · in the words of · as noted by · ibid.
title.en: citing and attributing sources: according to, cite, quote, in the words of, as noted by, ibid.

explain.ko: 출처를 밝히는 것은 학문적 정직성의 기본입니다. According to ..., As noted by ..., In the words of ... 같은 표현으로 주장의 출처를 밝히고, 직접 인용(quote)은 원문 그대로 따옴표 안에, 간접 인용은 자신의 말로 바꾸어 쓰되 출처를 밝힙니다. 각주(footnote)와 참고문헌(bibliography)은 학과가 요구하는 인용 형식을 일관되게 따라야 합니다. 이것이 표절을 피하는 방법입니다.
explain.en: Acknowledging sources is the basis of academic honesty. Expressions such as According to ..., As noted by ... and In the words of ... attribute a claim to its source; direct quotation uses the original words inside quotation marks, while indirect quotation is in your own words with the source acknowledged. Footnotes and bibliography must follow the citation style your department requires consistently. This is how to avoid plagiarism.

items.passage:
UNIVERSITY GUIDELINES
How to avoid plagiarism
When using other people's ideas or sentences, always acknowledge the source. Use quotation marks for direct quotation, and do not change the meaning when paraphrasing. Follow the citation style your department requires consistently.

trans.ko:
대학 지침
표절을 피하는 법
다른 사람의 아이디어나 문장을 쓸 때는 반드시 출처를 밝히세요. 직접 인용은 따옴표를 쓰고, 바꿔 쓰기는 의미를 바꾸지 마세요. 학과가 요구하는 인용 형식을 일관되게 따르세요.

questions.q: What should you always do when using ideas?

task.model: According to the study, lack of sleep reduces concentration. As noted by Smith, this effect is especially large in adolescents. In the words of one scholar, sleep is the foundation of learning. All sources must be acknowledged in the bibliography.

model_trans.en: According to the study, lack of sleep reduces concentration. As noted by Smith, this effect is especially large in adolescents. In the words of one scholar, sleep is the foundation of learning. All sources must be acknowledged in the bibliography.
